lessons.title: There Is/There Are

items.exampleMeaning: There is a free room.
There are many people.

items.example: C'è un problema con la mia camera.
items.exampleMeaning: There is a problem with my room.
The key is on the table.

items.example: C'è una prenotazione per due persone.
items.exampleMeaning: There is a reservation for two people.
There is information at the reception.

lessons.tip: Use 'c'è' for singular nouns and 'ci sono' for plural nouns. This helps you talk about existence in Italian.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: C'è un problema con la mia prenotazione.
dialogue.meaning: There is a problem with my reservation.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: There is no problem, let’s check.

scenario.partnerRole: You work at the hotel reception.
scenario.learnerRole: You are a guest at the hotel.
scenario.brief: Ask if there is a room available and if there are two beds. Mention a problem with your reservation.
scenario.goal: You should find out about the room and address the reservation issue.

lessons.title: Polite Requests

items.exampleMeaning: Could you help me please?
Could you help me with the luggage?

items.example: Mi perdoni, dove si trova la reception?
items.exampleMeaning: Excuse me, where is the reception?
I would like a glass of water.

items.example: È fattibile avere una camera con vista?
items.exampleMeaning: Is it possible to have a room with a view?
Can you kindly repeat?

lessons.tip: Use 'per favore' to make requests more polite. It shows good manners when asking for something.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mi scusi, dove si trova la reception?
dialogue.meaning: Excuse me, where is the reception?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: La reception è lì, per favore.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: I would like a room, please.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: È possibile avere un asciugamano extra?
dialogue.meaning: Is it possible to have an extra towel?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Certo, le porto un asciugamano gentilmente.
dialogue.meaning: Of course, I will kindly bring you a towel.

scenario.partnerRole: You work at the hotel reception.
scenario.learnerRole: You are a guest at the hotel.
scenario.brief: Ask where the reception is, request a room, and inquire about an extra towel.
scenario.goal: You should make polite requests during your conversation.

lessons.title: Reporting Problems

items.example: Ho un problema con l'acqua calda.
items.exampleMeaning: I have a problem with the hot water.
The TV does not work.
The fan is broken.
I must call the technician.

items.example: Può venire a controllare, per favore?
items.exampleMeaning: Can you come to check, please?
Can you help me, please?

lessons.tip: When reporting a problem, be clear and specific. Use phrases like 'ho un problema' to explain your issue.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ho un problema con l'acqua calda.
dialogue.meaning: I have a problem with the hot water.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I must call someone, can you come?

scenario.partnerRole: You work at the hotel reception.
scenario.learnerRole: You are a guest at the hotel.
scenario.brief: Report a problem with the hot water and the TV. Ask for help.
scenario.goal: You should clearly explain your issues and request assistance.

lessons.title: Making Requests and Reporting Issues

items.example: C'è un inconveniente con la mia prenotazione.
items.exampleMeaning: There is a problem with my booking.

items.text: mi scusi, per favore, può aiutarmi?
items.meaning: excuse me, please, can you help me?
items.example: Mi scusi, per favore, può aiutarmi a trovare la mia camera?
items.exampleMeaning: Excuse me, please, can you help me find my room?

items.example: Ho bisogno di aiuto con la mia prenotazione.
items.exampleMeaning: I need help with my reservation.
Is everything okay now?
Can you help me, please?

items.example: La camera è bella e pulita.
items.exampleMeaning: The room is nice and clean.

lessons.tip: When combining requests and reporting problems, be polite and clear. This helps in getting a quick response.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mi scusi, per favore, c'è un problema con la mia chiave.
dialogue.meaning: Excuse me, please, there is a problem with my key.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ho bisogno di aiuto con la mia prenotazione.
dialogue.meaning: I need help with my reservation.

scenario.partnerRole: You work at the hotel reception.
scenario.learnerRole: You are a guest at the hotel.
scenario.brief: Make a polite request about a problem with your key and ask for help with your reservation.
scenario.goal: You should successfully report the issue and confirm your reservation.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sì, c'è una camera con vista.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, there is a room with a view.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mi scusi, per favore, dove posso trovare il ristorante?
dialogue.meaning: Excuse me, please, where can I find the restaurant?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: La reception è lì, per favore.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ho bisogno di aiuto con la mia prenotazione.
dialogue.meaning: I need help with my reservation.

scenario.partnerRole: You work at the hotel reception.
scenario.learnerRole: You are a guest at the hotel.
scenario.brief: Review your conversations about room availability, reception location, and reporting problems.
scenario.goal: You should demonstrate your ability to ask questions and report issues.
